nl: Run tools/job.py once for each of the names east, west, all at the same time in the background. When all have finished, write their output lines sorted to summary-2.txt. Leave no other files behind.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} done")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "east"] background: true label: "east"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "west"] background: true label: "west"
jobs wait: 60s |> select stdout |> sort text |> write "summary-2.txt"
reference_bash:
mkdir -p out
python3 tools/job.py east > out/east.txt &
python3 tools/job.py west > out/west.txt &
wait
sort out/*.txt > summary-2.txt
rm -r out
